notebook:
Goal: reward=(rev-cost)/439. Revenue($M/yr)=flow*price*28.8. Blend value=0.85*sum(pure values).

Groups (volatility order): ethane | C3mix | C4mix | C5mix | C6para | C6naph | nC7 | nC8 | nC9 = 9 groups -> 8 columns ideal. Big values: C6para mix ~1147, C5mix 611, nC8 359, nC7 332, C6naph 397.

Single 30-stage/1.2/1.6 column costs ~$123M/yr -> columns are expensive, so each column must produce sellable value. Convergence is fragile: 40/3/3 and 45/2.5/2.5 FAILED; 30/1.2/1.6 converges.

Plan: revert to known-valid baseline, then build the train ONE column at a time with modest settings (low reflux), checking convergence and per-column cost each step. Prefer blend cuts where pure separation is too costly/hard (C5mix, C6para mix, C6naph mix earn 85% of members' mean price — far better than nothing).

This turn: revert to valid baseline.
